from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyExpense(BaseModel):
    """A company's non-operating expenditure reported in one financial document."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="The company name as named in the document")
    non_operating_expense: float | None = Field(description="The '营业外支出' amount reported, in yuan")
    report_period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period covered by the financial document")
    quote: str = Field(description="Verbatim line containing the non-operating expense amount")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_expenses: list[CompanyExpense]
